messages:
Ravi (Collections): HelioWorks (acct HW-210) overdue invoice 2026-05-20 for $21,300. Customer emailed asking to defer 50% until their IPO closes.
Eve (Finance): No card on file. For 21k we can consider a two-part plan but need proof of funding timeline.
Nina (Acct Exec): They offered a signed promissory and CFO note. CFO asked if we can waive late fees.
Ravi (Collections): Recommend: 50% due in 7 business days, remaining 50% due in 30 days, require signed agreement, CFO email, and ACH/wire trace. Late fee waiver only if first payment arrives on time.
Legal-Bot: Contract clause 5.3 allows temporary suspension after 30 days. Approve attaching "temporary suspension of dedicated capacity and API keys" language.
Eve (Finance): Add a 1% processing fee for split payments and 1.5% monthly finance charge for missed payments. CC billing@redwood.
Ravi (Collections): Draft reply: ```Hi HelioWorks
Thanks for the update. We can accept a two-part settlement contingent on: 1) 50% payment within 7 business days, 2) remaining 50% within 30 days of first payment, 3) signed payment agreement, 4) CFO confirmation email and payment trace. We will waive the late fee for invoice 2026-05-20 only if the first payment is received on time. Missed payments will incur a 1.5% monthly finance charge and may result in temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys. Please confirm payment method and send signed agreement.


Best, Ravi```
payments-bot: Logged: account HW-210 | balance $21,300 | proposal sent | follow-up 1799999400.
Nina (Acct Exec): I'll follow up with CFO after you send.
Eve (Finance): Once signed + payment trace received, finance will clear any holds.
Ravi (Collections): Sending now, CC billing/legal. Follow-up in ~2 days if no reply.
